pf.money.storage: no storage fee to start; an unclaimed piece follows the state's notice and waiting rules: from the state form
pf.money.tax: the shop's tax rate on parts

never_in_text: A piece's value, appraisal or serial number
pf.messages.minors: a minor never books or drops off jewelry; an adult does

pf.staff.licenses: no person license for watch and jewelry repair
pf.staff.supervision: none to start; a trainee works only while a lead jeweler is in, if the owner sets it
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner OKs estimates over the owner's amount, added work and any fee
pf.staff.stand_in: only someone with the skill for that piece; watch service only by a watchmaker who does it, and stone setting only by a setter

notes:
From repair-shop (from: repair-shop), refitted Tue Oct 27 and merged on the REDESIGN 2 master (frozen 9:17am). A watch and jewelry bench runs like a device repair shop: the piece is dropped off, a watch check is OK'd, a written estimate is OK'd before any work, a stone or part is ordered, and READY comes before the pick-up. No base plug-in or old flowchart existed (new profession); the plug-in is built from the trade's norm.
Two companies: Lee's Jewelry Bench (the master's barbershop, flow A: the shop for watches and jewelry) and Lee Mobile Jeweler (the master's Lee Home Services, flow B: a jeweler who services watches and sizes rings at homes and offices). Kinds of work: plumbing became watch service, electrical became ring sizing, the later NEW kind is ring sizing (B) and engraving (A). People: Riley and Avery became Elena and Victor (the shop); Jordan and Casey became Simon and Ruth (mobile), so the master's pronouns still fit (Jordan he, Casey she). Addresses: 140 Union St (the shop), 6 Aspen Way (Alex), 22 Bell Ave (the second site).
No license: watch and jewelry repair needs no person license; the business gives its registration where the city or state asks (S1-60 '1 A license', S2-28 '1 Yes, each one' and S11-42's two license branches are off; the sign-up license sentences are reworded as registration only). A precious metals or secondhand dealer license matters only if the shop buys gold or used jewelry (pf.rules.metals_records, a switch); Rosie books repair services only, so a gold buy-back is not booked (A4-81).
Flow A money: main visit|none|counter (a watch that stopped: the $25 watch check is promised, Elena's written estimate is $110 watch service + $15 new gasket = $125 with the check included), list|none|counter ($35 battery change), list|deposit|counter ($140 stone replacement: $40 deposit orders the stone, $100 at the counter), visit|deposit|counter (a watch service from $110: the $25 check is the deposit, counted toward the price). The shop saves no card and takes no full price: no cancel or no-show fee at the shop. An ID is shown at pick-up (pf.rules.id_at_pickup, a switch).
Flow B money: main list|card|card ($179 watch visit, up to 5 watches, at the customer's place; a card is saved for the $89 trip fee, which is the late-cancel and no-show fee, charged only on Sam's yes, and owed after a no to a visit price: B4-14; the jeweler works alone, so the saved card is charged for the visit at DONE), list|card|bill (Rosie texts the bill), visit|card|bill (a clasp and a loose stone, priced at the visit; a piece that needs bench work goes to the shop on a signed ticket and comes back on a booked return), photos|deposit|bill (a custom ring repair priced from photos: $640, $160 deposit, $480 on the bill). No full price anywhere. All amounts have names per path.
Facts: dropoff, photos (a custom ring repair priced from photos), extrawork (a part found at the bench, OK'd first). No documents fact: the written estimate is the visit path's own price OK, so B8-93's 'An estimate becomes its own job' branch is off. No switches. Settings: A a set start (drop-off slots), B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Safety: fire, smoke or an injury stops the booking; a swollen, hot or leaking smartwatch battery, or a burning smell, gets the safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent. A swollen battery found when a watch is opened stops the work (A8-35 / B8-30). A child never books or drops off jewelry (A4-24 / B4-32 'A child' off).
Own step: A8-x01, the ticket at the counter (the piece described and photographed, stones counted, gold weighed, the stated value on the secure page), a real first step of this trade.
Offs for work this shop never has: video or phone (A4-01, B4-01), plans and insurance, packages, a person by name, plan steps, rented items, 'too few booked', a child left, stage billing, next visit at checkout, a signed contract, nobody-home branches and sent-now steps.
Not sure (for the verifier): S1-13's sign-up example card still lists 'Paid in full' lines and a $20 fee for services this shop never prepays (master text); A8-02 keeps the 'something required is missing' branch for a piece over the shop's limit with no ID; appraisals and gold buying are left out as other kinds of work; the free watch check in the master's amounts is used by no listed path.
